name: Killian Lu
description: Killian Lu is a human Silverquill mage-student at Strixhaven, son of Dean Embrose Lu, known for his ink magic and for learning white magic.

description_citations.text: "Killian Lu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

description_citations.work: Strixhaven: School of Mages: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Strixhaven: School of Mages: card flavor text (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Killian Lu is a human Silverquill mage-student at Strixhaven, son of Dean Embrose Lu, known for his ink magic and for learning white magic.

citations.text: "Killian Lu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Strixhaven: School of Mages: card flavor text
citations.text: Strixhaven: School of Mages: card flavor text (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: While serving detention, Killian's stray ink magic corrupted Dina's experiment into a living swamp monster; they defeated it, he was fatally injured, and Dina healed him.

citations.text: "Dina", section "Student". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Killian Lu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He was tempted by an Oriq agent and drank a potion that shut out empathy, then learned white magic with Doco's help and won his father's approval.

citations.text: "Killian Lu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In a class duel he lost his voice, but he signed for light, declined the Oriq's offer of a mask, and healed Vickus with white light.

citations.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.
"A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.
"A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sent the surviving students, including Killian, to find the Invocation of the Founders while Embrose fought compleated faculty.

citations.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

bio.text: The students read the Invocation's petals on the roof, and Killian dug his father out alive afterward.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

bio.text: As a graduate he turned a forbidden binding duel between Crown and Verdis into a ritual of communion with his own sigil, and he drafted an addendum to the Naming Tithe involving non-binding duels.

citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.
"Forum of Amity", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Killian is alive and, as of the latest story, a recent graduate mentoring younger students at the Forum of Amity.

citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian's ink magic cuts a tree and interrupts her concentration.
timeline.quote: A snap broke her concentration.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's wave of ink knocks Dina down before he helps her up.
timeline.quote: a wave of inky force was rolling toward Dina

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The corrupted ritual turns the pests into a quivering orb of ink magic, which sprouts tendrils into the ground.
timeline.quote: But instead of dead pests, sitting on the ground was a jet-black sphere of ink magic quivering as if alive.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina drags Killian away as the trees wail from the corrupted spell.
timeline.quote: she took the young man's wrist, pulled as hard as she could, and ran away from the site

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina recognizes Killian as Dean Lu's son and shows him the forbidden tome.
timeline.quote: Up close, Dina recognized the young man as the son of Dean Lu

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Returning, they find the pest den destroyed and the pests gone.
timeline.quote: There were no signs of the pests, and the only remnants of their den were splinters floating on the surface of the creek.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian explains his detention token and that Silverquill lost the Mage Tower match.
timeline.quote: I cost my team that point, and Silverquill lost the Mage Tower match.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina and Killian bond over losing their mothers; Dina's glade is gone.
timeline.quote: My mother died when I was very young.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: They find a wounded vineclinger, and Killian saves Dina from its swipe with ink barbs.
timeline.quote: Acting quickly, Killian pulled her away with one arm

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina deduces the creature is headed toward Sedgemoor and is just newly born.
timeline.quote: Toward Sedgemoor.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: They find the monster coiled around ancient trees, and Killian proposes breaking the ink-magic heart.
timeline.quote: If we could just access its heart again, we could break the spell

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina feeds Killian lionspaw leaves so he can see in the dark.
timeline.quote: Lionspaw has side effects on humans,

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian attacks the weakened creature with ink blades and hammers.
timeline.quote: With Killian's yell came two sickle-shaped blades of pure ink magic slicing into the body of the creature.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The creature rakes Killian across the chest.
timeline.quote: close enough for it to shift its mass and rake him across the chest with a pair of shadowy claws

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina binds Killian with roots, then faces the creature as it crashes down on her.
timeline.quote: And then, like a great tidal wave, the creature crashed down upon her.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina wakes in the Widdershins infirmary and learns Killian dragged her there.
timeline.quote: The boy is tenacious, dragging you all the way from the bog with a festering wound.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina gives Killian a drink and he knows compassion for the first time.
timeline.quote: Dina raised her cup to Killian's lips, and for the first time in his life, he knew compassion.

citation.text: Infuse with Vitality (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Killian's stray ink magic corrupts Dina's experiment, creating a living swamp monster; they defeat it, Killian is fatally injured, and Dina sacrifices the spell in her blood to cure him.
timeline.quote: Dina cured her newfound friend.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Student". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian's ink bolt disrupts Dina's resurrection spell, creating a swamp monster; they defeat it and Dina heals his fatal wound.
timeline.quote: Killian and Dina managed to defeat the monster

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian is tempted by an Oriq agent and drinks a potion that shuts out empathy, then learns white magic with Doco's help and wins his father's approval.
timeline.quote: he just in time learned to use white magic

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian readies a volume curse against Professor Razineth in a class duel on the Rose Stage.
timeline.quote: readied a curse meant to tear Professor Razineth apart

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Razineth attacks viciously, defeating six students before Killian.
timeline.quote: Razineth was unrelenting and vicious with his attacks

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian conjures three massive spheres of ink.
timeline.quote: he swept his arms through the air, summoning thick, inky ropes

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian traps Razineth in ink shackles that the professor severs, then hurls an ink sphere.
timeline.quote: a line of ink, thinner than the width of a spider's web, had been snaking upward from the ground like a tall vine behind him

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's ink bursts into trolls that Razineth absorbs into a shield.
timeline.quote: where its pieces landed immediately sprang ink-made trolls wielding hammers and axes

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's final orb becomes a cyclone that engulfs Razineth.
timeline.quote: it touched down, catching the professor in its torrent

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Razineth hits Killian with a black ink arrow while he is distracted.
timeline.quote: a soft t had leapt from Razineth's tongue

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian meets the empathetic gaze of Fannessa Fjyorne among the fallen.
timeline.quote: She gave him an empathetic smile of solidarity.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian succumbs to Razineth's curse and suffers despair and hallucinations.
timeline.quote: like the six who fell before, succumbed to a cruel defeat

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Shaile tells Killian in the infirmary that he must embrace the light.
timeline.quote: You must learn to embrace the light every now and again.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Shaile warns him not to spend all his magic in one place.
timeline.quote: Don't spend all your magic in one place.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian leaps onto a boat to meet his father using a water-solidifying spell.
timeline.quote: Killian spoke the spell aloud as he soared through the air

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa teases Killian on the boat and talks of light magic.
timeline.quote: So that's how the great Killian Lu is never late for anything

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa suggests a Bow's End elixir for his sore throat.
timeline.quote: I might know a girl who knows a guy at Bow's End that can whip one up no problem.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa urges Killian to step out of the shadows and leaves on a boat to Bow's End.
timeline.quote: You should step out in the sun once in a while, Killian Lu

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint gives Killian a book about the Mute Quillancer who used sign language.
timeline.quote: Dobarius Egolt, the Mute Quillancer

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Embrose scolds Killian for relying on his inkling and being vulnerable.
timeline.quote: Reliance on your inkling makes you dependent, weak, and unfocused

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Embrose rejects light magic and tells Killian Oriq hearts must be broken.
timeline.quote: Oriq hearts do not bend in battle; mage hunter souls are never mended.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Embrose tells Killian that his harsh teaching is for his own good.
timeline.quote: This is for your own good, son.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Doco emerges from Quint's book as Killian's voice weakens.
timeline.quote: a mass of black ink dribbled out of it, then formed itself into an inky bobble-headed creature

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian meets Dina outside Bow's End, who is on a date with Vickus.
timeline.quote: It was his friend Dina, also a second-year.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian finds Fannessa seated alone like a queen at Bow's End.
timeline.quote: She was seated by herself at the end of one long table like a great queen at a feast.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian signs for light and the candles intensify.
timeline.quote: It worked.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Vickus, jealous of Killian and Dina, absorbs a pest's life force and challenges him.
timeline.quote: The pest gave a screech as its life force left and entered his host.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian drinks Fannessa's elixir, which heals his throat and floods him with power.
timeline.quote: The warmth of the honey-flavored liquid coating his throat brought with it intoxicating, renewed energy.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian grows spider legs of ink and webs Vickus, shooting an ink arrow into his chest.
timeline.quote: The black ink arrow shot across the tavern and tore into Vickus's chest.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's ink enters Vickus, turning his eyes black.
timeline.quote: Killian watched as his opponent's eyes faded from gold to black.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's voice vanishes so he cannot call the curses back.
timeline.quote: Killian opened his mouth to call the curses back, but to his dismay, no sound escaped.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian signs mercy and heals Vickus with white light.
timeline.quote: Vickus's eyes began to shine like two glowing suns, and his body rippled with healing gold light.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa admits she has been following Killian for a long time.
timeline.quote: We've been watching you for a very, very long time.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa reveals herself as an Oriq agent in armor and offers a mask.
timeline.quote: Fannessa too became engulfed in purple flames that burned her Silverquill robes away, revealing jagged, gray Oriq armor underneath.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa orders Killian to put on the Oriq mask and join them.
timeline.quote: Put the mask on, Killian Lu.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian declines the Oriq's offer and the mask evaporates.
timeline.quote: He slowly shook his head, declining the Oriq's offer.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian encases Fannessa in light and shoots a golden arrow of mercy into her.
timeline.quote: An arrow, golden and shimmering, imbued with virtuous intention, was conjured.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's signed light blinds and immobilizes the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Killian's spells flowed like water down their backs and along their tails, where it consumed their termini, immobilizing them.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Students led by Dina blast the mage hunters to pieces.
timeline.quote: The final attack came from Dina, who hurled an enormous ball of pulsing beryl magic at the horrid creatures and shattered them into pieces.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Vickus says Killian's light has created a way to turn the Oriq toward the light.
timeline.quote: You've created a way to bring them to the light.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Embrose, Shaile and Razineth watch with the crowd as Killian wins the day.
timeline.quote: Embrose, arms folded and face stern, was standing amid the crowd

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Embrose shows a faint sign of approval, and patriscrit on Killian's palm declares he can create.
timeline.quote: it was what one might consider the beginnings of a smile, a sign of mild approval

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: When the Phyrexians invade, Vess sends the surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint summons the spirit of Dean Herrian the Second from a statue, who reveals they are directly under the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: How can you be lost when you're under the Biblioplex?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dean Shaile seizes Killian, demanding the whereabouts of his father.
timeline.quote: Where is your father?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dean Embrose Lu arrives in a storm of ink that melts compleated professors and rescues Killian.
timeline.quote: Dean Embrose Lu landed beside them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Embrose flings the students out of the fight so they can find the invocation, and Killian sends him supportive words.
timeline.quote: And without warning lashes of black whipped around the students' torsos

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
timeline.quote: but alive, and himself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends the students to find the Invocation; Embrose fights compleated faculty.
timeline.quote: Embrose arrived to fight off the full group of compleated faculty

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a tea ceremony ends on a bitter note, Killian steps up as a second for a ritual duel at the Forum.
timeline.quote: the ceremony ended on a bitter note, and at the Forum of Amity, there was but one recourse for bitterness.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian faces a young leonin opponent and sees his desperate amber stare.
timeline.quote: His amber eyes tracked Killian with an intensity that gave Killian pause

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian counters the leonin's strikes, then deliberately drops his guard and takes a blow to the chest.
timeline.quote: Killian shut his mouth and braced for impact.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian wakes with a concussion and meets Crown, and the healer Verdis, who teases Crown.
timeline.quote: "Crown," the leonin said gruffly.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian explains that the duels vent feeling, but no one leaves satisfied and no one can let things go anymore.
timeline.quote: Like no one knows how to let things go anymore."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Commotion in the Presiding Chamber draws Killian, reminding him of his father fleeing the invasion.
timeline.quote: the last glimpse of his father's back before—

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The mediator Embrose Lu arrives amid the feuding Silkmeadow and Kathorr delegations.
timeline.quote: Here stood Silverquill's own shadow dean, Embrose Lu.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian learns Crown and Verdis were tutored together, and Verdis fostered with Crown's kin.
timeline.quote: "We were tutored together, when we were kids."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Over dinner, Embrose says he heard Killian lost a duel; Killian does not tell him he did it on purpose and instead mentions his father's new publication.
timeline.quote: "I picked up your new publication."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: After the ritual, Embrose tells Killian the conciliators must now prove themselves and he will trouble himself no longer.
timeline.quote: It's time for the conciliators to prove themselves worthy of their peoples' trust."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian follows Crown and Verdis and overhears them planning a binding duel.
timeline.quote: "It needs to be binding."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Crown and Verdis draw sigils for a duel on the terms of rights, water and all, which Killian realizes is forbidden.
timeline.quote: Instead, Doco read the emblems for "rights" and "water" and "all."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian offers to bear witness, and weaves a sigil of togetherness, shared and communion between theirs, turning the duel into a ritual of communion.
timeline.quote: The emblems he layered onto his sigil were not negations, nor modifiers, but expansions

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian shows Embrose his draft of an addendum to the Naming Tithe, and Embrose is moved to try to express his appreciation.
timeline.quote: "What I don't know," said Embrose, "is if I've ever properly expressed what I appreciate about you."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian offers his father a hand, and Embrose takes it to join in the ritual.
timeline.quote: "Yes," he said. "I think I'd like to see myself."

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Winnowing Season" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: During the invasion Killian focuses on bolstering his allies.
timeline.quote: During the invasion, Killian knew his magic could not overpower the Phyrexians alone, and he focused on bolstering his allies.

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Killian Lu, Dina, Rootha Squallheart and other returning characters are now recent graduates practicing magic in the wider world.
timeline.quote: are now recent graduates of Strixhaven University, putting their magic to practice in the wider world

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian is defeated in a formal duel by Crownflower Majen and healed by Verdis.
timeline.quote: was defeated by Crownflower Majen of Silkmeadow

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Forum of Amity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian intervenes in the binding duel by creating his own sigil, reshaping its terms.
timeline.quote: Killian intervened by creating his own sigil to bear witness

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Forum of Amity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Embrose defeated a host of compleated faculty, letting Killian and friends find the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: Embrose Lu defeated a host of compleated faculty members

citation.text: "Embrose Lu", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian intervened in the Crownflower and Verdis duel by creating his own sigil, reshaping the duel's terms.
timeline.quote: Killian intervened by creating his own sigil to bear witness

citation.text: "Embrose Lu", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Inspired by his father's poetry, Killian Lu drafts an optional addendum to the Naming Tithe involving non-binding duels.
timeline.quote: In 4565, inspired by his father's poetry, Killian Lu drafted an optional addendum to the ritual

citation.text: "Forum of Amity", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Professor Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: Professor Vess tasked a small group of surviving students

citation.text: "Invocation of the Founders", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The students find the living Invocation and learn it must be read together in five parts.
timeline.quote: They realized that they had to follow the elder dragons' example and read all five parts together.

citation.text: "Invocation of the Founders", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
